fixtureLimits: The chapter fixtures prepare the summary for the prior twenty missions and initial role ownership. They do not replay the island/prior campaign to enter Harbor.
Harbor completion flags and objective positions are not fixture-granted; normal simulated movement/E, runtime timing, physical crate travel and pad/LOS rules are exercised.
Controlled guard-capture callbacks, suspicion values and pending-leap negative fixtures probe rules; they are not observations of a human stealth playthrough or a live guard catch.
Checkpoint recovery retains earned sorting and restages each undelivered crate on its own final three-metre approach; exact pre-reload world position is not persisted.

All six actual BoxCollider pairs are checked at Rigidbody poses after reload and on each coroutine frame through resumed arrivals. False ComputePenetration output directions are undefined and are not physical measurements.
limits: Exactly cases 08/25/26/27 pass on this candidate. This does not establish a pass for all 27 scenarios.
Null graphics and simulated input do not establish rendered case 21, films/water/settings visuals, GPU performance, physical keyboard input or a human playthrough.
